### Safety checklist

- [ ] Exported as Agent only with memory set to None.
- [ ] No source-environment respond-to allowlist.
- [ ] No remote avatar URL, credential, private key, or personal data.
- [ ] No command, Hook, MCP, filesystem, or network capability.
- [ ] Artifact SHA-256 and size match the catalog manifest.
- [ ] Full system prompt and source were reviewed.
- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run lint`, and `npx tsc --noEmit` pass.

Passing this checklist is not an endorsement or a guarantee of publication.
